notes: Off/on correspond to closed/open. The initial camera survey was not counted. The two independently moving upper-cabinet leaves are reported separately; their closing transitions occur close together and the exact second-leaf midpoint is mildly perspective-ambiguous.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a compact kitchen showing manipulation of a refrigerator door, two separate upper-cabinet leaves above the cooktop, and a base-cabinet drawer beside the oven.
